columns.name: workout_id
columns.defaultConstraints: REFERENCES workouts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

dialectAwareDefaultConstraints.sqlite: REFERENCES workouts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workouts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "courses" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "axis" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "course_versions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "course_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES courses (id), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "length" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_name" TEXT NULL, "protocol" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pm5', "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "distance_dm" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "average_pace_cs" INTEGER NULL, "average_watts" INTEGER NULL, "average_stroke_rate" REAL NULL, "stroke_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "workout_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES workouts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "workout_name" TEXT NULL, "course_version_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES course_versions (id), "planned_laps" INTEGER NULL, "planned_duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "imported" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("imported" IN (0, 1)), "average_heart_rate" INTEGER NULL, "max_heart_rate" INTEGER NULL, "rmssd_ms" INTEGER NULL, "pause_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "paused_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "health_exported_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "samples" ("session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "t_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "distance_dm" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pace_cs" INTEGER NULL, "watts" INTEGER NULL, "stroke_rate" INTEGER NULL, "heart_rate" INTEGER NULL, "calories" INTEGER NULL, "wall_ms" INTEGER NULL, "active_ms" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "strokes" ("session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "t_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "distance_dm" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stroke_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "drive_length_meters" REAL NULL, "drive_time_ms" INTEGER NULL, "recovery_time_ms" INTEGER NULL, "peak_force_newtons" REAL NULL, "average_force_newtons" REAL NULL, "watts" INTEGER NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "raw_packets" ("session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "t_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "characteristic_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bytes" BLOB NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "zones" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "axis" TEXT NOT NULL, "length" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pace_fast_cs" INTEGER NULL, "pace_slow_cs" INTEGER NULL, "spm_min" INTEGER NULL, "spm_max" INTEGER NULL, "resistance_level" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "course_segments" ("version_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES course_versions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "length" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pace_fast_cs" INTEGER NULL, "pace_slow_cs" INTEGER NULL, "spm_min" INTEGER NULL, "spm_max" INTEGER NULL, "resistance_level" INTEGER NULL, "zone_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES zones (id), "zone_name" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("version_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_blocks" ("workout_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "course_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES courses (id), "laps" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("workout_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "laps" ("session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "lap_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_wall_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_wall_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_distance_dm" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_distance_dm" INTEGER NOT NULL, "complete" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("complete" IN (0, 1)), "in_zone_share" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("session_id", "lap_no"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lap_segments" ("session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "lap_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "distance_dm" INTEGER NOT NULL, "in_zone_share" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("session_id", "lap_no", "position"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rr_intervals" ("session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "t_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rr_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pauses" ("session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "start_wall_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_wall_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("session_id", "start_wall_ms"));
CREATE INDEX samples_session_time ON samples (session_id, t_ms)
CREATE INDEX strokes_session_time ON strokes (session_id, t_ms)
CREATE INDEX raw_packets_session_time ON raw_packets (session_id, t_ms)
CREATE INDEX course_versions_course ON course_versions (course_id, version)
CREATE INDEX rr_intervals_session_time ON rr_intervals (session_id, t_ms)
